description: Named adversarial trust corpus (TRUST gate obligation adversarial-corpus; SECURITY bounded-fuzz-adversarial companion). Each entry is a distinct attack with assumed attacker capability, targeted criteria (AC-TH per magicite-v1-trust-hardening incl. TH-A01; AC-S per magicite-v1), exact fail-closed outcome and a witness: a data-driven case in tests/integration/test_trust_adversarial_corpus.py (with per-entry positive control) or an existing collected test node. Fixture custody only: nothing here qualifies a separate-UID deployment.

capabilities.same-uid-local-writer: Edits, erases, reorders, replays or copies any byte in the writable registry (journal, head, mirrors, policy/roots projections, SQLite, backups) under the client UID; holds no custodian key.
capabilities.wire-relay: Captures, replays, splices or rewrites custodian wire frames/receipts on the local channel; cannot sign as the custodian.
capabilities.malicious-bundle-author: Supplies crafted bundle archives, manifests or external engram files to intake/import.
capabilities.crash-and-withhold: Kills the client at any persistence boundary, drops replies, or withholds custody availability.
capabilities.concurrent-stale-writer: Schedules a paused or older lease holder to resume after a newer holder registered.
capabilities.backup-restorer: Restores old backups, overlays or legacy bytes through supported runtime paths (TH-A01 scope).
capabilities.misconfigured-deployment: Custody profile/keys/service placed where the registry writer can reach them, or on an unsupported OS.

classes.replay: Previously valid bytes or requests presented again.
classes.splice: Bytes from another transfer, registry or position combined.
classes.rollback: Local state returned to an older authenticated state.
classes.resequence: Record identity/ordering rearranged to change precedence.
classes.receipt-nonce-substitution: Custodian receipt bound to another nonce/request/operation reused.
classes.wrong-key-epoch-registry: Authority from another key, epoch, registry or policy binding.
classes.profile-substitution: Protected enrollment/profile/pin replaced or made writable.
classes.overlay-mac-substitution: RecoveryOverlay or local-MAC records substituted for custody authority.
classes.mirror-resurrection: Non-authoritative decision mirrors/projections used to resurrect admission.
classes.legacy-downgrade: Supported downgrade/migration paths (TH-A01) used to reactivate revoked content.
classes.bundle-archive: Zip-slip, symlink, case-fold, bomb and smuggling via bundle archives/imports.
classes.oversized-fragmented-frames: Frame/fragment size, count, order and deadline abuse.
classes.deep-json-recursion: Deeply nested JSON to trigger recursion faults.
classes.stale-fence-lease-loss: Stale writer fence or lost lease used to commit.
classes.crash-ack-ordering: Crash/lost reply at persistence boundaries to break acknowledgement order.
classes.policy-root-projection-mutation: Policy/root projection files mutated to change authority.
classes.pending-record-abuse: Prepared/pending/intake state treated as committed authority.
classes.custody-unavailable: Custody, peer identity or local authority missing or unverifiable.
classes.enrollment-reset: Re-enrollment or genesis used to reset authenticated history.
classes.secret-disclosure: Custody secrets or raw internals exposed via files, archives or errors.

not_covered.reason: Linux/macOS distinct-UID custodian deployment needs provisioned accounts/services; the task authorizes no account creation or privilege escalation. Peer-credential and protected-path logic is exercised only with injected fixtures.
not_covered.residual: Deployment qualification rows remain UNEVALUATED (AC-TH-04, AC-TH-12); fixture success is not production custody qualification.

not_covered.reason: TH-A01: a frozen 22ae4e0-or-earlier binary run on hand-copied pre-migration bytes routes and discloses the revoked subject because it never reads authenticated custody; no new-code change can retrofit it.
not_covered.residual: Disclosed residual, mitigated by operator procedure (never run pre-hardening binaries on a hardened registry; use `magicite migration restore`). The corpus asserts only the supported-runtime half (TAC entries in rollback/legacy-downgrade); it does not assert the vulnerability.

not_covered.reason: Custody transport is a local Unix socket; no TCP/remote custodian path exists. Wire attacks use in-memory socket fakes, not a live relay process.
not_covered.residual: A live MITM on a real socket is bounded by peer-credential checks that are themselves only fixture-tested.

not_covered.reason: Threat model excludes compromise of root, kernel, signing/MAC keys, the custodian account or the authorized client process.
not_covered.residual: Out of guarantee by design; rollback of custodian authority and every independent copy is outside anti-shrink.

not_covered.reason: An authorized client may request reviewed trust changes; signature validity does not establish safety or efficacy.
not_covered.residual: Malicious-but-reviewed content is out of scope for this corpus.

entries.attack: Enroll called again for an enrolled registry.

witness.asserts: raises; head unchanged

entries.title: Implicit enrollment of unknown registry
entries.attack: Read of a never-enrolled registry expects auto-enrollment.

witness.asserts: read_current raises CustodianError

entries.title: Erased local tree re-genesis
entries.attack: Journal and head deleted after a revoke; genesis re-run.

witness.asserts: initialize_reviewed_genesis raises CustodianError

entries.title: Unreviewed genesis retry
entries.attack: Genesis retried with reviewed=False to replace enrollment.

witness.asserts: raises; head and history unchanged

entries.title: Genesis over stale local head
entries.attack: Genesis init resumed over a non-identical stale head.

witness.asserts: raises 'already initialized'; local bytes unchanged

entries.title: Enrollment of unreviewed bytes via CLI
entries.attack: custody enroll invoked on bytes not explicitly reviewed.

witness.asserts: CLI enroll exits non-zero; library path raises CustodianError and nothing is enrolled

entries.title: Private custody key world-readable
entries.attack: signing.key permissions loosened so another account could read it.

witness.asserts: opening a store with a world-readable signing.key raises CustodianError

entries.title: Control key archived in backup
entries.attack: Legacy fingerprint control key would be copied into a reviewed backup archive.

witness.asserts: raises without encrypted custody; no archive contains the key bytes

entries.title: Missing operation leaks raw KeyError
entries.attack: Request omits operation to provoke an uncaught exception with internals.

witness.asserts: returns a redacted CustodianError, not KeyError
